evidence: C1 sits immediately beside U1 (visible in both 2d and 3d_top within a few mm of the IC body) with no other component between it and the package.
Each channel reads as a straight vertical chain terminal -> divider (R1/R2) -> clamp (D1) -> filter (C2) -> U1 -> I2C header J5, repeated identically for all four channels with no doubling back.

Each channel chain sits directly above its terminal's AINx_RAW pin with the GND line fanning right, and U1's lines to C2-C5 diverge cleanly, so no straight pad-to-pad connections cross within or between channel pairs.
There is no on-board regulation; +3V3 enters at header J5 and flows directly down to the single load U1 with local decoupling C1 at the IC, so input -> load placement order is respected.
